body: J4 landed (36a33c1) and your priority ruling is being built: R43 makes the athlete the payee at GameState.gd:10253, shipping E23 as the default - no manager contract filed, the gym's delta from the purse is 0. That opens the hole your own Area 1(e) refused to fill with an invented gym cut: the gym still pays weekly payroll and upkeep. J5 is the honest answer. Four areas: dues and the training floor; the manager share as a REVENUE line (what makes it collectible - do NOT re-derive the E2/E3 caps); whether a gym supplying corners is paid at all; the gym as a sponsored entity (without redoing J3 D15 or your own E17). End on one plain question: after R43, what does the gym live on, and how much ships without an invented number - 'less than the payroll costs' is an acceptable answer. Calls G1-G18, assertions G19-G34. Top tier, effort high, Fast off. Full spec: research/TASK_J5.md. Research only; Claude writes your HANDOFF block.
topic: J5 ASSIGNED - THE GYM'S OWN LEDGER
